introH2: Why Stay Near Ha Yaek Lat Phrao? And How to Pick the Right Hotel?
introHtml: Ha Yaek Lat Phrao is the intersection where BTS Ha Yaek Lat Phrao (Green Line) and MRT Phahon Yothin (Blue Line) meet — one of Bangkok's best transit hubs, and one that almost nobody outside Thailand talks about. From here you can reach Siam and Asok directly on BTS, connect south via MRT to Silom and Sukhumvit, and link to airport rail for both Suvarnabhumi and Don Mueang. Central Plaza Ladprao, one of Bangkok's larger malls, and Union Mall are right at the interchange, so supermarkets, restaurants and pharmacies are all within a few minutes' walk. Hotels here are considerably cheaper than Siam or Sukhumvit while offering near-identical transit access. This roundup covers 5 hotels we have reviewed in depth — all with real scores, real guest voices and prices compared across 3 platforms.
mrtHtml: The two transit anchors for this area are BTS Ha Yaek Lat Phrao and MRT Phahon Yothin, which share a connecting walkway at the interchange. The Plimplace Hotel is the closest property to a BTS station in this set — about 5 minutes on foot to BTS Phahon Yothin 24. Apartelle Jatujak Hotel and TD Bangkok Hotel are both in Soi Ladprao 1, about 7 minutes' walk to MRT Phahon Yothin; the apartelle also provides a free hotel shuttle to the station. The Lux Ladprao 10 is in Soi Ladprao 10 — a motorbike taxi from the soi entrance reaches MRT Ladprao in under 5 minutes. Grandview Ladprao Hotel is in Soi Ladprao 15, about 870 m (~11 min walk) to MRT Ladprao.

entries.storyHtml: Apartelle Jatujak Hotel is a 30-room boutique apartelle opened in 2018 in Soi Ladprao 1 — scoring 9.4 from 332 reviews, Staff 9.6, Cleanliness 9.5, the highest in this set. Every room comes with a full kitchenette, Smart TV with free Netflix and a private balcony. The free neighbourhood shuttle runs to MRT Phahon Yothin, Union Mall, Lotus's and anywhere within 2 km all day — guests cite this consistently as the property's biggest differentiator. A 24-hour snack and coffee lounge on floor 2 is an added bonus. Worth knowing: there is no swimming pool and no in-house breakfast; some rooms have thin walls that carry noise from neighbours — request an upper floor if you are a light sleeper.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Get the shuttle WhatsApp number at check-in — the free service covers MRT, Union Mall and Lotus's all day and can save you money on every trip out. If noise sensitivity is a concern, ask for an upper-floor room at check-in.

entries.storyHtml: The Lux Ladprao 10 is a 3-star aparthotel in Soi Ladprao 10, Chatuchak — scoring 8.8, Location 8.9, Cleanliness 8.9, Value 8.9. The main draw is a combination of amenities that is hard to find at this price: outdoor pool, children's pool, spa, gym, in-house restaurant, apartment-style rooms with full kitchens and free parking. entries.storyHtml: The Plimplace Hotel is a 79-room 3-star hotel attached to the landmark Elephant Building on Phahonyothin Road — scoring 8.7 from 367 reviews, Location 8.8, Cleanliness 8.9, Value 8.9. Walk out the door and BTS Phahon Yothin 24 (Exit 4) is 5 minutes away; one stop takes you to Central Plaza Ladprao. Rooms are a consistent talking point in reviews — Deluxe rooms start at 35 sqm with a private balcony, which is larger than most hotels in the same price bracket in Bangkok. The saltwater pool on floor 2 is clean and well-regarded. Worth knowing: walls are thin and noise from neighbouring rooms carries, especially late at night; late check-out is strictly enforced.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Use Exit 4 at BTS Phahon Yothin 24 — the hotel is directly next to the Elephant Building. Bring THB 1,000 cash for the deposit at check-in. Head to the saltwater pool early (07:00) when the water is cleanest and the terrace is quiet.

entries.storyHtml: Grandview Ladprao Hotel is a 14-room 3-star budget property in Soi Ladprao 15, Chatuchak — scoring 7.0 from 195 reviews, Location 7.9, from THB 600/night, the lowest entry price in this set. Its main strengths are free parking — hard to find in this neighbourhood — and a 7-Eleven on the ground floor of the building. Central Plaza Ladprao and Union Mall are 5 minutes by car or Grab. Worth knowing: the property operates on a self-service model with no 24-hour front desk; check-in requires advance notice via LINE at least 24 hours ahead. Air-conditioning inconsistency and cleanliness issues have been flagged in some recent reviews, which explains the score of 7.0.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Always message the hotel via LINE at least 24 hours before arrival with your check-in time and parking request — there is no full-time front desk. If it is hot midday and MRT is your destination, a quick Grab is cheaper than you think and far more comfortable than the 11-minute walk.

faqTitle: FAQ — Common Questions About Hotels in Central Ladprao Bangkok

faq.q: Where is Ha Yaek Lat Phrao (Central Ladprao) in Bangkok, and how do I get there?
faq.a: Ha Yaek Lat Phrao is a major interchange in the Chatuchak district of northern Bangkok, where BTS Ha Yaek Lat Phrao (Green Line) and MRT Phahon Yothin (Blue Line) connect. Central Plaza Ladprao and Union Mall are right at the junction. From Suvarnabhumi Airport, take the Airport Rail Link to Phaya Thai and transfer to BTS Green Line to Ha Yaek Lat Phrao (about 45–55 min). From Don Mueang Airport, a Grab takes approximately 25–30 minutes.

faq.q: Which hotel in Central Ladprao has the highest score and the most reviews?
faq.a: Apartelle Jatujak Hotel holds the highest score in this set — 9.4 from 332 reviews on Trip.com (9.2 from 514 reviews on Booking.com), with Staff scoring 9.6. For review volume, TD Bangkok Hotel has the largest base with 483 reviews at a score of 8.7 and Location 9.3 — the most thoroughly tested property in the set despite being a small budget guesthouse.

faq.q: Which hotel is closest to BTS or MRT in the Central Ladprao area?
faq.a: The Plimplace Hotel is the closest to a BTS station — about 5 minutes on foot to BTS Phahon Yothin 24 (Exit 4, next to the Elephant Building). Apartelle Jatujak Hotel and TD Bangkok Hotel (both in Soi Ladprao 1) are about 7 minutes' walk to MRT Phahon Yothin; Apartelle also offers a free shuttle. The Lux Ladprao 10 (Soi 10) uses a motorbike taxi to MRT Ladprao in 5 minutes. Grandview Ladprao Hotel is about 870 m from MRT Ladprao.

faq.q: Which hotel in Central Ladprao has a swimming pool?
faq.a: The Lux Ladprao 10 has an outdoor pool, children's pool, spa and gym — the most complete amenity package in this set, starting from THB 1,200/night. The Plimplace Hotel has an outdoor saltwater pool on floor 2, open 07:00–21:00 daily, with a gym on the same floor — guests consistently rate the pool quality positively.

faq.q: Is there free parking near Central Ladprao for guests?
faq.a: Grandview Ladprao Hotel offers free parking for guests (limited spaces, must request when booking) — the most straightforward free-parking option in this set and the reason it makes the roundup despite a lower score. Apartelle Jatujak Hotel and The Lux Ladprao 10 also have on-site free parking. The Plimplace Hotel has free parking with EV charging.

faq.q: What is the cheapest hotel in Central Ladprao with decent reviews?
faq.a: TD Bangkok Hotel at THB 860/night holds a score of 8.7 from 483 reviews — the best value-for-quality option in this set. If your absolute priority is the lowest nightly rate, Grandview Ladprao Hotel starts at THB 600 (Suite THB 750), but accept its self-service nature and score of 7.0. For a mid-budget option with BTS access and a saltwater pool, The Plimplace Hotel starts at THB 1,000 with a score of 8.7.
